journal_lines: The water darkened beneath. Something vast passed. It did not stop.
Shadow below the hull. Too large. Kept moving. It did too.
Something old in the deep water. Stayed near the surface. It stayed deep. Agreement reached.
Eye in the deep water that did not belong to a fish. Did not belong to anything I had a word for.
The shadow moved against the current. The current was wrong about itself, briefly.
Felt the slowness of it. Slower than time. Faster than I had supposed it would be.
Held breath at the surface. Heard a sound like distant doors closing one by one.
Stayed in the shallows the rest of the day. The shallows seemed reasonable.
